chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from Asad ibn Abu Al-A'ala, from Muhammad ibn Al-Fudayl, from the one who saw Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),
and he was in Ihram, having exposed his back until he showed it to the sun, he was saying: 'Here I am among the sinners, here I am!'.

key_terms.إِحْرَامٌ: The state of ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam say during his Talbiyya while in Ihram?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) personal practice of reciting the Talbiyya with the phrase 'among the sinners' (al-mudhnibin), reflecting the Shia emphasis on humility and repentance during Hajj. It serves as a practical model for pilgrims to adopt a humble demeanor, even if it involves uncovering the back to the sun, while maintaining the spiritual focus of the pilgrimage. This specific addition underscores the theological concept of seeking divine mercy through acknowledgment of one's sins.
